title: The Law of Cleansing for the Leper
description: The Lord gives Moses detailed instructions on how a person healed of leprosy is to be cleansed. The priest goes outside the camp, and two birds are used in the cleansing ritual along with cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop. One bird is slaughtered, and the other is released alive. The one being cleansed washes their clothes, shaves off all hair, and bathes. On the eighth day, a male lamb, flour, and oil are brought as a guilt offering, sin offering, and burnt offering. Blood and oil are applied to the lobe of the right ear, the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot. Those who are poor may bring a smaller offering.
